subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the final rebased head be approved with these grouped third-party action updates across credentialed, release, security-scanning, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: Automated checks cannot establish whether maintainers accept the combined supply-chain and privilege-boundary changes, especially for the Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL actions.

options.title: Verify and approve final pins
options.body: Inspect each final action SHA and upstream release delta, then merge after required checks settle on that exact head.
